title: Docker: images, applications and operating containers
summary: 42 detailed lessons from the first container to reproducible builds, Compose, networking, durable data, security, delivery and recovery. Study offline and use clearly scoped optional host labs.

lessons.title: Containers, images and the process model
lessons.outcome: Classify source code, image tag, container and volume. Explain what evidence proves a web application is serving.
lessons.lab: Classify source code, image tag, container and volume.
lessons.verification: Four objects with separate creation and deletion events.

lessons.title: The Linux engine, WSL 2 and your first inspection
lessons.outcome: Produce a minimal setup checklist. Explain a safe response to discovering a remote context.
lessons.verification: Bash, local Linux engine, Compose and sufficient allocated resources.

lessons.title: The filesystem, writable layers and container lifetime
lessons.outcome: Make a restart-versus-recreate persistence table. Choose storage for user progress and transient scratch data.
lessons.verification: Writable layer survives restart but not removal; volumes follow their own lifetime.

lessons.title: Processes, PID 1, signals and graceful shutdown
lessons.outcome: Write a four-step graceful shutdown sequence. Design a shutdown acceptance check for a writer.
lessons.lab: Write a four-step graceful shutdown sequence.
lessons.verification: Stop new work, bound draining, close owned resources, exit.

lessons.title: Dockerfile instructions and the first reproducible image
lessons.outcome: Write a minimal Dockerfile for a single file app. Define build and runtime acceptance separately.
lessons.lab: Write a minimal Dockerfile for a single file app.
lessons.verification: Base, workdir, explicit source copy and foreground command.

lessons.title: Build context, .dockerignore and accidental data exposure
lessons.outcome: Design a context inventory for the fixture. Describe source and image privacy acceptance.
lessons.lab: Design a context inventory for the fixture.
lessons.verification: A short list of necessary public build inputs.

lessons.title: Layers, cache invalidation and efficient rebuilds
lessons.outcome: Reorder dependency metadata and app source conceptually. Design a build-performance experiment.
lessons.lab: Reorder dependency metadata and app source conceptually.
lessons.verification: Stable dependency inputs precede rapidly changing source.

lessons.title: Environment variables, command arguments and configuration
lessons.outcome: Design defaults and validation for a timeout variable. Write a public configuration evidence record.
lessons.lab: Design defaults and validation for a timeout variable.
lessons.verification: A documented default plus finite positive bounded numeric parsing.

lessons.title: Ports, loopback and the first browser request
lessons.outcome: Draw a host browser request path. Choose public and internal endpoints for a two-service app.
lessons.lab: Draw a host browser request path.
lessons.verification: Browser, host socket mapping, container interface and app listener.

lessons.title: Logs, exit status and observation before repair
lessons.outcome: Write an incident observation packet. Design log content for a public teaching server.
lessons.verification: Image identity, lifecycle state, recent logs and one failing request.

lessons.title: Compose services, projects and a complete application
lessons.outcome: Write the project lifecycle command sequence. Design a two-copy experiment without interference.
lessons.lab: Write the project lifecycle command sequence.
lessons.verification: Validate, build, up with readiness, inspect, then down.

lessons.title: Health checks, startup order and real readiness
lessons.outcome: Design a readiness endpoint for a file-backed teaching app. Write separate health and acceptance assertions.
lessons.lab: Design a readiness endpoint for a file-backed teaching app.
lessons.verification: A bounded non-destructive test of required local capability.

lessons.title: Named volumes, bind mounts and persistence experiments
lessons.outcome: Build a persistence evidence table. Choose a safe cleanup policy for progress.
lessons.verification: Before value, old/new container IDs, volume identity and after value.

lessons.title: First capstone: build, serve, replace and explain
lessons.outcome: Produce the complete build-and-request evidence packet. Teach the project to a beginner without using hidden host state.
lessons.lab: Produce the complete build-and-request evidence packet.
lessons.verification: Build logs, model validation, health state and exact JSON response.

lessons.title: BuildKit, cache mounts and build secrets
lessons.outcome: Design a cold-build check. Describe a dependency acquisition policy.
lessons.verification: Remove reliance on cache while preserving declared public inputs.

lessons.title: Multi-stage builds and runtime dependency boundaries
lessons.outcome: Design a builder-to-runtime artifact list. Specify final-image acceptance.
lessons.verification: Executable or package plus explicit required runtime assets.

lessons.title: CPU architectures, image indexes and cross-platform builds
lessons.outcome: Design a two-platform evidence matrix. Write an honest portability claim.
lessons.verification: Separate build and execution columns for amd64 and arm64.

lessons.title: Bridge networks, service DNS and container-to-container traffic
lessons.outcome: Draw the DNS-to-request sequence. Design an internal-only database connection.
lessons.verification: Resolve app, connect to container port, send HTTP request, inspect body.

lessons.title: Network isolation, gateways and outbound connectivity
lessons.outcome: Design a frontend/backend attachment table. Define outbound acceptance for an offline worker.
lessons.verification: Each service joins only the networks needed by its role.

lessons.title: Users, UID ownership and writable data paths
lessons.outcome: Design a non-root image setup sequence. Write a permission acceptance check.
lessons.lab: Design a non-root image setup sequence.
lessons.verification: Create required paths, set ownership, then select the runtime user.

lessons.title: Backups, restores and proving data recovery
lessons.outcome: Design a separate restore target. Produce a recovery evidence packet.
lessons.verification: A new owned volume with no overwrite of the source.

lessons.title: Resource limits, contention and honest performance experiments
lessons.outcome: Design a controlled CPU comparison. Define a safe resource stress boundary.
lessons.verification: Same input and image, one changed limit, several bounded measurements.

lessons.title: Read-only filesystems, capabilities and least privilege
lessons.outcome: Write a least-privilege acceptance pair. Review a hardening change without overstating security.
lessons.verification: One required action succeeds and one forbidden action fails.

lessons.title: Rootless engines, user namespaces and host trust
lessons.outcome: Draw the daemon-socket authority path. State a support claim for a new rootless setup.
lessons.verification: Socket access can permit host-impacting container requests.

lessons.title: Image names, digests and an offline transfer
lessons.outcome: Design an offline handoff record. Define offline acceptance for the study app.
lessons.verification: Archive checksum, image identity, platform and expected command.

lessons.title: Compose overrides, profiles and configuration review
lessons.outcome: Create an override for a public message. Write a reviewable configuration launch record.
lessons.lab: Create an override for a public message.
lessons.verification: Only the intended environment value changes in the effective model.

lessons.title: Intermediate capstone: a recoverable two-tier teaching system
lessons.outcome: Build an independent restore demonstration. Write a beginner operator handoff.
lessons.verification: New target state equals the exported counter while source remains intact.

lessons.title: Registries, tags, digests and deliberate publication
lessons.outcome: Design a release identity record. Describe a safe publication review without performing it.
lessons.verification: Source revision, immutable image identity, platform and tested behavior.

lessons.title: Software bills of materials and image provenance
lessons.outcome: Design an evidence linkage table. Write a supply-chain review for the fixture.
lessons.verification: Every record names the same image digest and platform scope.

lessons.title: Vulnerability findings, patching and dependency updates
lessons.outcome: Design a minimal base-image update. Write a patch decision record.
lessons.verification: Change the resolved base deliberately and rerun relevant acceptance.

lessons.title: CI builds, test layers and artifact promotion
lessons.outcome: Design a parallel test partition. Write a release gate with honest limitations.
lessons.verification: Independent groups with explicit ownership for shared fixtures.

lessons.title: Debugging minimal images without changing the contract
lessons.outcome: Create a vantage-point diagnosis table. Write a repeatable minimal-image incident procedure.
lessons.verification: Host, peer and app observations with distinct address scopes.

lessons.title: Restart policies, failure loops and idempotent startup
lessons.outcome: Design idempotent counter initialization. Define restart acceptance for a stateful app.
lessons.verification: Create absent state once and validate existing state.

lessons.title: Application migrations and durable state versioning
lessons.outcome: Design a v1-to-v2 synthetic record conversion. Write a migration release plan.
lessons.lab: Design a v1-to-v2 synthetic record conversion.
lessons.verification: Preserve counter value and set a validated new schema version.

lessons.title: Image size, startup latency and measurement
lessons.outcome: Design a readiness latency measurement. Write an optimization recommendation with evidence.
lessons.verification: Fixed image, known cache condition and repeated bounded readiness timing.

lessons.title: Compose on one host and the limits of orchestration
lessons.outcome: Build a failure-domain matrix. Choose an orchestration approach for a stated workload.
lessons.verification: Process, container, engine, host and external dependency rows.

lessons.title: TLS, reverse proxies and publishing responsibly
lessons.outcome: Draw proxy and upstream trust boundaries. State what would be required before public exposure.
lessons.lab: Draw proxy and upstream trust boundaries.
lessons.verification: Explicit client-facing and internal hops with identities and timeouts.

lessons.title: Incident response, disk pressure and scoped cleanup
lessons.outcome: Design an incident evidence packet. Write a scoped recovery and cleanup plan.
lessons.verification: Failure symptom, time, resource inventory and bounded relevant logs.

lessons.title: Namespaces, cgroups, OCI and the runtime beneath Docker
lessons.outcome: Draw the client-to-process runtime chain. Describe the shared-kernel security implication.
lessons.verification: Client, engine, runtime setup, mounts and application process.

lessons.title: Runtime secrets, configuration files and controlled disclosure
lessons.outcome: Design a no-disclosure validation message. Write a secret data-flow review.
lessons.verification: Report presence or a bounded error without the sensitive value.

lessons.title: Scaling replicas, shared state and concurrency traps
lessons.outcome: Design a replica-readiness checklist. Propose a correct scaled counter architecture.
lessons.verification: Routing, state concurrency, sessions, resource budget and recovery.

lessons.title: Advanced capstone: a release, recovery and teaching handoff
lessons.outcome: Assemble a source-bound release packet. Teach the full system and defend its limits.
lessons.verification: Exact source, image, platform, commands and observations.
